results.title: When the state’s uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) emitted fire from the sky during a counterterrorism operation in Gao, it killed Ahmadu’s enti
results.description:
When the state’s uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) emitted fire from the sky during a counterterrorism operation in Gao, it killed Ahmadu’s entire family and seven other unarmed locals. The bombing was delivered summarily; only that it fell on the wrong targets, survivors say, noting that the incident has reduced the settlement to a ghost of itself.

Two years later, only human wreckage is left in the village of Amasrakad, bombarded by the Malian junta in the name of destroying terrorists.
